name: c12_scarf_tie
purpose: Two Choice Scarf Basculegion enter together at one Speed (the real Team C on both sides): runSwitch sorts their SwitchIn handlers, which are Choice Scarf's onStart. It only removes a choicelock, which an entering Pokemon never has, so the reference's tie draw decides nothing and the converter drops it. Found by the differential loop (A3, case fz_11_44 of seed 11).
